correctness.rationale: Normal feet on a revolution surface reduce to a meridian stationarity equation. Its astroid discriminant is intersected exactly with the ellipsoid. An admissible single crossing, explicit volume integration, positive-coefficient monotonic set nesting and a bounded-uniform high-aspect expansion establish all claims. A deterministic checker corroborates closed form vs quadrature, stationarity roots and Monte Carlo.

value.rationale: The mean normal count is a classical, motivated global geometric invariant. The theorem fully classifies a natural three-dimensional smooth convex family, including an interior caustic-crossing singularity, strict inverse determination of aspect ratio and sharp \(r^{-4}\) slenderness law; none is an arbitrary isolated numerical invariant.
